events.evidence: Russia suspends New START arms inspections of its nuclear weapons in response to travel restrictions imposed by the United States and its allies
The Pentagon announces that it will send Ukraine an additional $1 billion in military assistance
The Federal Bureau of Investigation executes a search warrant at Mar-a-Lago, the primary residence of former U.S. president Donald Trump

label.note: New START suspension and major Ukraine aid signal continued geopolitical escalation; Mar-a-Lago search adds U.S. political noise.
